gen-press-start-2p-gf-roboto: Roboto reads as a plain sans, with generous mouths on its round letters. Roboto's low contrast between capitals and lowercase height is what lets Press Start 2P's pinned-apart, pixel-cut shapes stand out.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-ruda: Ruda reads large and wire-thin, with wide-mouthed rounds in the lowercase. Up top, Press Start 2P swells slightly in each bowl like pressed glass, while the sans below has no pinched joints or flared ends to compete.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-saira: Retro and playful up top, then a plain sans whose rounded letters stretch tall and whose s keeps a see-through gap. Saira should move along smoothly down a page.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-sarpanch: Sarpanch reads open and approachable, its lowercase e showing a clear mouth under a compact ascender line. Down a full page, Sarpanch would feel steady and contemporary, while Press Start 2P keeps its tempered thick-thin curves to the title.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-savate: Chunky retro fun meets a tidy, modern body. Press Start 2P is best at pinned-apart display shapes with big bowls, and Savate is best at sturdy hairlines and open jaws on every curve.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Schibsted Grotesk keeps its a and e big and its terminals open. Soft contrast in every curve of Press Start 2P sits against that sans, whose low contrast makes the difference the pair's strongest quality.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-sen: Sen builds its lowercase tall, with one constant line tracing each letter. And Press Start 2P, with its soft shifts in thickness and far-apart cut-out spacing, adds the fun the body leaves out.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-sintony: Far-apart, cut-out letters with big open bowls give this heading its character. Sintony's chunky, tall midzone and smooth curves make the pair's strongest quality a clear jump from retro fun to a plain sans.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans draws every stroke without any thick-and-thin modulation, its rounded letters open and its lowercase standing tall like cut acrylic stencil pieces. Press Start 2P brings tempered modulation as its edge.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-sofia-sans-semi-co: Press Start 2P brings pinned-apart, cut-out fun. Beneath it, Sofia Sans Semi Condensed hums softly as a plain sans, with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals and a big visible entrance into every curve.
